description: Builds a dated study plan from today to the exam date on Rotate Pilot's course material: learning blocks per area (Part 107 in proportion to the official FAA weights) with the Rotate Pilot lessons that cover each one where available, a mixed-practice block for weak areas and a final block of full timed practice tests, plus the free FAA references for that exam.

exam.description: FAA knowledge test: part107 (drone / Remote Pilot, UAG), ppl (Private Pilot Airplane, PAR), ifr (Instrument Rating Airplane, IRA), cpl (Commercial Pilot Airplane, CAX), atp (Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine, ATM).

title: Day-by-day FAA study plan
